items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was Peter Matz, Irv Kostel, various of us who were musical directors for these shows... Peter Matz was the general conductor and orchestral arranger. I did the dance music for the various, whatever sequences needed to come up.

ctx.x: I'm gonna say this is 1959 we're talking about.

Right. I was musical director for Polly Bergen on a regular basis for her regular weekly show, or every two weeks, I believe it was. At any rate, and as such there was Peter Matz, Irv Kostel, various of us who were musical directors for these shows, were called upon by the various records companies to quote unquote cover the hit parade. In other words, we would put out an album of the hits of the day and it would be a gig for us, you know. None of us ever expected to make too much money out of it because … but…
I wanted to do and the records, I have them and I'll tell you where I got 'em. I think I paid $50 for one over at (laughs)
